name: toss-invest-mcp
description: Bundles the split-buy-strategy skill for the Toss Securities Open API MCP server (Korean/US market-data tools plus order/account tools, off by default). This manifest does not wire up the MCP server itself — that needs a local JDK 21 build and Toss credentials, which do not fit Codex's plugin distribution model safely. Configure the server with `codex mcp add` or ~/.codex/config.toml; see docs/install-plugins.md.
